reason: The introduction also points to the nursery outflow changing material, so I’ll try it against the gas in the tail.

expectation: The outflow will alter or carry away some of the tail gas.

reaction: I was surprised that the outflow could help trigger another generation of stars after clearing the original nursery.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the outflow into the cold cloud was most worthwhile: it connected the clearing of one nursery to star formation elsewhere.

leastWorthwhile.text: My attempt to combine the outflow with tail gas was the least worthwhile choice; the introduction pointed to changing material, but I guessed the wrong cloud.

surprise.text: The dense cloud could cool and contract after the outflow's shock, forming stars rather than simply being swept away.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary, though I did not anticipate the specific outflow–cold cloud pairing.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the newly formed stars and see how their surroundings change, especially after seeing material cycle into another cloud.
